notes.title: FOX Update!!!
notes.content:
Dear Community,

Our first post-release update fixes a few minor issues, and apart from that we've reworked and [b]improved the jump mechanics.[/b] 
For all those who thought it was too hard, try it again!

A few general words:
Thanks for playing "Auf Abwegen" and your incredible feedback - be sure that we read every single comment ;)
Also we are very impressed with the performances achieved on the leaderboards - congratulations!

Foxy Greetings
InSayn
